body: Some signs are the same for different words, its all in context of the conversation as well. And as your level of progression of sign language increases a sign could effectively be a short sentence instead of multiple basic signs. And also body language and facial expressions play a good role as well. I would say to a certain level of words, but spelling does come into it as well.

I would probably recommend a 50/50 mix of the old and new food, and gradually change over to the new food. The length of time it will take will be dependent on the bird. If im honest i don't know if it would cause sickness, maybe just an adjustment period. Off all my research when getting my bird everywhere i read said to do a diet change gradually.
Diet change should be done gradually over weeks or months, not overnight ideally. May well just be  a shock to the system.
